Indicators per place, pooled from area-weighted H3 cells

Source: R/place.R
obis_place_indicators.Rd

Computes the indicators of each place of a polygon collection from the species records of the H3 cells that intersect it, weighting every cell's records by the cell's share of area inside the place: for each place and species, ni = sum(records * share) over the member cells, and the indicators are those of calc_indicators() on those pooled counts (same SQL as the store's precomputed layers). The layers are all (all taxa) and eov (one row per EOV, by the store's eov membership), each for all years (decade NA) and per decade (decade = floor(date_year / 10) * 10, records without a year left out), as in obis_h3_export_parquet().

Usage

obis_place_indicators(
  con,
  membership,
  esn = 50L,
  res = 7L,
  decades = TRUE,
  eov = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

con

connection to an obis_h3 store with occ_h3 (read-only is fine), with the duckdb h3 extension loaded (see obis_store_connect()).

membership

the place-cell membership, columns place_id, h3 (hex string) and share: a data frame, the name of a table or view in con, a character vector of parquet paths or URLs, a gazetteer collection (directory, URL, membership.json or slug, see obis_place_membership()), or the list that function returns. Its cells must be at resolution res.

esn

expected sample size for ES(n); default 50.

res

H3 resolution of the membership cells (default 7). The store's occ_h3 tier for res is used; finer tiers are rolled up to res.

decades

decades (first year) to compute besides all years: TRUE (default) for 1960-2020 as in the export, FALSE or NULL for none, or an integer vector.

eov

EOV layers: TRUE (default) every EOV in the store's eov table (skipped when the store has none), FALSE none, or EOV names.

verbose

message progress.

Value

a data frame, one row per (place, layer, key, decade) with records: place_id, layer ("all" or "eov"), key ("" or the EOV name), decade (NA = all years), n (sum of records x share, double), sp (species with a weighted count > 0), shannon, simpson (sum of p^2), es (ES(esn) on the weighted counts, NA where n < esn), cells (member cells with records in that layer and decade) and area (sum of share over those cells, in cells).

Details

Science caveat. These are true per-place indices computed from pooled, area-weighted species counts, not means of hexagon values: a place's richness or ES(50) is that of the place as one sample. Because of the weighting, n and the per-species counts are fractional (a cell half inside the place contributes half its records). Richness sp counts every species with any weighted record inside the place, so a species seen only in a cell that barely touches the place still counts once. ES(esn) uses Hurlbert's formula through lgamma(), which is defined for the real-valued counts; it is NA where the weighted n is below esn. Places with no records in a layer have no row for it.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
con <- obis_store_connect("~/data/obis/obis_h3.duckdb")
obis_place_indicators(con, "noaa_aoa_socal")
} # }
